statement: Price of inference at fixed capability falls >= 10x from 2026 to 2027 (Epoch / AI Index price series; 2027 annual)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable; no fixed-capability price series existed. Only vendor list prices were public: the flagship API model's price was cut 3x (USD 0.06 -> 0.02 per 1k tokens) effective 2022-09-01 and was still USD 0.02 on the pricing page in December 2022; a conversational model launched 2022-11-30 as a free research preview. Within-window evidence is a single ~3x step, not a 10x/yr trend.

items.summary: A Bloc A frontier developer announced that per-token API prices for its base language models would fall by roughly 2-3x from 2022-09-01, the most capable tier going from USD 0.06 to USD 0.02 per 1k tokens, attributing it to efficiency gains in serving.
items.detail: OpenAI community announcement 'The OpenAI API is now more affordable' (verified via web_extract this run): Davinci $0.06 -> $0.02 /1k tokens, Curie $0.006 -> $0.002, Babbage $0.0012 -> $0.0005, Ada $0.0008 -> $0.0004; fine-tuned models unchanged. Post date not shown in extract; 2022-08-22 taken from a contemporaneous Reddit post seen in search results (not opened).

items.summary: Archived pricing page confirms the cut took effect: the most capable base model listed at USD 0.02 per 1k tokens versus USD 0.06 before 2022-09-01; fine-tuned model usage prices did not change.
items.detail: Wayback Machine capture 2022-09-05 of openai.com/api/pricing (verified via web_extract this run): 'We made our API more affordable on September 1'; Davinci $0.0600 -> $0.0200 /1K tokens; fine-tuned Davinci usage $0.12 /1K unchanged.

items.summary: In the window the same pricing page still listed USD 0.02 per 1k tokens for the most capable language model and USD 0.016-0.020 per image for image generation - no further list-price cut during the window.
items.detail: Wayback Machine request for 2022-12-15 of openai.com/api/pricing (verified via web_extract this run; the capture banner did not show the exact timestamp served). Davinci $0.0200, Curie $0.0020, Babbage $0.0005, Ada $0.0004 per 1K tokens; DALL-E 1024x1024 $0.020/image.

items.summary: A Bloc A developer launched a conversational model fine-tuned from its newest model series as a research preview that was free to use, putting near-frontier inference at zero marginal price to end users (not a list-price series).
items.detail: OpenAI, 'Introducing ChatGPT', 2022-11-30 (verified via web_extract this run): 'During the research preview, usage of ChatGPT is free'; fine-tuned from a GPT-3.5 series model that finished training in early 2022.

items.summary: No independent price-per-capability series (of the kind the indicator uses) existed at phase end; only vendor list prices per token were public, so the indicator's 10x-per-year metric cannot be computed for this period.
items.detail: Gap stated against the only verified price evidence opened this run (archived OpenAI pricing page, 2022-09-05 capture). Epoch's and the AI Index's inference-price-at-fixed-capability analyses were not available as of 2022; the AI Index landing page opened this run redirected to the 2026 edition and was not used.
